name: 1/1 Kareshi Kanojo
source:
Realistic romance that “might happen to you”.
The concept of the game is to “show a side of your girlfriend that only your boyfriend can see, all to yourself.
By becoming the heroine’s boyfriend, the user can discover unexpected aspects of her that she only shows to herself.
It will be a game where you can become the heroine’s boyfriend and discover unexpected aspects of her that only you can see.
translation:
“可能发生在你身上”的现实浪漫。
游戏的理念是“向你自己展示只有你男朋友才能看到的女朋友的一面。
通过成为女主人公的男朋友，用户可以发现她只向自己展示的意想不到的方面。
在这款游戏中，你可以成为女主角的男朋友，并发现她身上只有你才能看到的意想不到的一面。”
